answer: For reef and delta restoration votes, prevent a Sybil haven by charging one escrowed coin-hour per voting unit. Validators accrue credits from consensus-checked lock records, then consume those credits once across all polls and keys. Splitting 100 coin-hours among 100 accounts still buys only 100 units. Another unit needs another coin-hour, so the same deposit cannot fund unlimited simultaneous ballots. Wealth and borrowed capital can still concentrate influence.
